card.name: Inside longer words, early pieces
card.fires_on: Short word pieces in the middle of a longer word, just after its opening letters. Often seen in Aminosyn and Aminocaproic, and in words like prostheses, quiescent and woollens.

modes.label: Amino- drug names
modes.description: The piece after Amin in amino-acid product names such as Aminosyn.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Early pieces of rarer words in general text, including a Dutch word and an Arabic name.
